usage: aura evo log [--json] [--all] [--run ID|last] [--front] [--lineage ID]
       aura evo report --html DIR

  log --front       only the non-dominated candidates (first two objectives)
  log --lineage ID  ancestor chain of one record, root -> ID
                    ID is a record id (<run>#<seq>), the #<seq> suffix,
                    or a candidate name (v2 "candidate" or the target column).
                    An unknown id is an error when the log has records.
  report            score curve, Pareto scatter, HV curve, QD heat map,
                    lineage tree, candidate folds, surrogate pre-screen
